items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: That was the date with Cedar Walton, Kenny Dorham, Tootie Heath, Kenny Walden, Tudy Heath

ctx.x:
Yeah, but it isn't always that way. You can make a record, and unless you plan it, and you know, have the right engineers and all this right ingredients, it ain't going nowhere, unless one of those big companies really want to push you, and they don't care how good the record is.

My friend Clifford Jordan got an album that I'm really crazy about, and that's called 'Starting Time' -- it's out of one of those pseudo-companies out of Riverside, Jazzland, and that was recorded in '61, and just because every tune on…

But, even though they haven't re-issued it, we saw it a couple years ago in a record store on the lower East Side for twenty-some dollars, and it's not as old as some of the older ones that were reissued.
